blocks.text: Michael Sager, Kelvin Miranda and Anton Vinzon are set to bring their heartthrob appeal to one stage as they headline a pre-Valentine concert next year. During the media conference on Saturday, Oct. 31, the trio discussed what they can offer to the Gen Z audience beyond their image as heartthrobs. Sager said being an artist also comes with the responsibility of using one’s platform to spread positivity and set a good example. “I think the Gen Zs is a very special generation, kasi talagang lahat sila, gusto kumilos, they’re seeking for change, their movements are different, and I’m proud to be […]...
